title: 第一卷第25章 要么滚要么跪第一卷第26章 兵道宗师
content_zh:
;;
售卖了蛇胆，君无邪手里的青铜贵宾卡变成了白银贵宾卡，里面的资金增加了一千万。
有了这笔钱，他对竞拍和气果拥有十足的信心。
“苏管事，天净楼的拍卖会有没有什么入场要求？”
他想尽量了解详细些，毕竟这里是凤天城，不是青阳城，有些规矩可能会不同。
“平常的拍卖会，进行资金认证后，便可直接入场，但天净楼这次的拍卖会比较特殊，也是我之前没有给君公子说清楚。”
“有何不同？”
“不同之处在于，平常的拍卖会在天净楼的拍卖场举行，而即将举行的拍卖会则是在天净楼的灵舟之上进行。”
“在灵舟上举行拍卖，有什么特殊的用意吗？”
君无邪有些惊讶，既然天净楼有拍卖会场，那么在灵舟上搞，岂不是多此一举？
“这是天净楼两大传统拍卖会的举行方式之一，称之为灵舟拍卖会，在凤天城开往都城的灵舟上举行，可以吸引更多城市里有实力的竞拍者。”
“明日一早，灵舟起航，举行拍卖会之前，灵舟会途经数十座与凤天同级的城市。”
“明白了。”君无邪点了点头，道：“我要去都城，正好需要乘坐灵舟。”
“公子要去都城？”苏岚眼睛微微一亮，笑着说道：“公子日后若还有四阶资源出售，一定要来找我。”
君无邪点头：“放心吧，资源肯定会有的。”
苏岚见他说的这么肯定，心下一喜，当即站了起来，道：“我正要去都城任职，君公子可愿同行？”
“当然。”
君无邪和苏岚并肩走出聚宝斋，刚出大厅，迎面走来一群人。
为首的是位二十上下的少年，趾高气扬，眉宇间尽显倨傲。
“站住！”

少年双手背负，冷幽幽地打量君无邪，看到他身边的管事苏岚，眼里闪过一抹惊怒之色。
眼前这个乡巴佬，穿的这么破烂，居然与聚宝斋苏管事并肩而行？
何德何能？
在这凤天城，他温子旭也算是号人物了。身为温家少爷，单凭身份便极其尊贵，却也从未让聚宝斋的管事这般对待过。
“听说你抢了本少爷的车位？”
少年嘴角噙着冷笑，眼露杀机。
君无邪微微一怔，这才看到少年的身后有两个躺在地上的断腿青年，不就是那两个看守么？
那眼前这个跋扈蛮横的家伙，应该就是温家的少爷了。
“要么滚，要么跪。”
君无邪平静地看着温子旭，说出的话却让其脸色瞬间铁青。
“乡巴佬，你说什么？”温子旭简直不敢相信自己的耳朵，在这凤天城，谁敢这样跟他说话，吃了熊心豹子胆了？
“你知道本少爷是谁吗？在这凤天城，敢这么跟本少说话的，坟头草都两米高了！”他面目略显狰狞，对身后的几人说道：“给我弄死他，让他知道本少爷之威不可犯！”
“嘿，不知死活的小子。”
温子旭身后两个中年人上前就要出手。
轰的两声。
他们刚到君无邪面前就飞了出去，骨断筋折，丹田破碎，抱着小腹蜷缩在地，惨叫不止。
“你找死！”

After selling the snake gallbladder, the bronze VIP card in Jun Wuxie's hand turned into a silver VIP card, and the funds in it increased by ten million.
With this money, he has full confidence in bidding for Qiguo.
"Manager Su, are there any entry requirements for the Tianjing Building auction?"
He wanted to know as much detail as possible. After all, this was Fengtian City, not Qingyang City, and some rules might be different.
"In normal auctions, you can enter directly after the funds are verified, but this auction in Tianjing Building is special, and I didn't make it clear to Mr. Jun before."
"What's the difference?"
"The difference is that the usual auction is held at the auction house of Tianjing Building, while the upcoming auction will be held on the spiritual boat of Tianjing Building."
"Is there any special purpose for holding an auction on the spirit boat?"
Jun Wuxie was a little surprised. Since there is an auction venue in Tianjing Building, wouldn't it be unnecessary to do it on the spirit boat?
"This is one of the two traditional auctions held in Tianjing Tower. It is called the spirit boat auction. It is held on the spirit boat bound for the capital from Fengtian City. It can attract more powerful bidders in the city."
"Tomorrow morning, the spirit boat will set sail. Before the auction, the spirit boat will pass through dozens of cities at the same level as Fengtian."
"I understand." Jun Wuxie nodded and said, "I want to go to the capital, and I need to take the spirit boat."
"Young Master is going to the capital?" Su Lan's eyes lit up slightly and she said with a smile: "Young Master, if you still have fourth-level resources for sale in the future, you must come to me."
Jun Wuxie nodded: "Don't worry, there will definitely be resources."
Seeing that he was so sure, Su Lan was overjoyed. She immediately stood up and said, "I am about to go to the capital to take up a post. Mr. Jun, would you like to go with me?"
"Of course."
Jun Wuxie and Su Lan walked out of Jubaozhai side by side. As soon as they left the hall, a group of people came towards them.
The leader was a young man in his twenties, arrogant and arrogant.
"Stop!"
The young man put his hands behind his back and looked at Jun Wuxie coldly. When he saw Su Lan, the steward next to him, a look of shock and anger flashed in his eyes.
The country bumpkin in front of me, dressed in such shabby clothes, is actually walking side by side with Jubaozhaiguo Su?
How can you be so virtuous?
In this Fengtian City, he, Wen Zixu, is considered a famous figure. As the young master of the Wen family, he is extremely noble based on his status alone, but he has never been treated like this by the stewards of Jubaozhai.
"I heard that you took away my parking space?"
The young man had a sneer on his lips and murderous intent in his eyes.
Jun Wuxie was startled for a moment, and then he saw two young men with broken legs lying on the ground behind the young man. Aren't they the two guards?
The domineering and arrogant guy in front of him should be the young master of the Wen family.
"Either get out or kneel down."
Jun Wuxie looked at Wen Zixu calmly, but what he said made his face turn livid instantly.
"Country bumpkin, what did you say?" Wen Zixu couldn't believe his ears. Who dared to talk to him like this in Fengtian City?
"Do you know who I am? In Fengtian City, the grass on the grave of anyone who dares to talk to me like this will be two meters high!" He said to the people behind him with a slightly ferocious expression: "Kill him and let him know that my power is untouchable!"
"Hey, you reckless boy."
Two middle-aged men behind Wen Zixu stepped forward to take action.
Two bangs.
As soon as they arrived in front of Jun Wuxie, they flew out. Their bones were broken, their tendons were broken, and their Dantian was shattered. They curled up on the ground holding their bellies, screaming in agony.
"You're looking for death!"
